title: Timeline of the four caliphs
subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Summer 1: The Rightly Guided Caliphs: Uthman and Ali
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y6 lesson 27 (Pupil PDF worksheet: timeline of the four caliphs)
intro: Lesson 27: What the four caliphs teach us: review and quiz. To understand what the four Rightly Guided Caliphs teach us by recalling their lives in order and comparing their qualities

questions.q: Give one achievement for each caliph.
questions.a: Abu Bakr collected the Qur'an's pages; Umar the calendar; Uthman copies of the mushaf; Ali judged with knowledge.
questions.model: Teacher does Abu Bakr: 'He was the first caliph and had the Qur'an collected into pages.'

questions.q: Unit quiz in the portal: twelve questions on Uthman and Ali and the order of the four caliphs, then complete the timeline sheet with a quality for each.
questions.a: Answers on the quiz key; timeline with Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, Ali and one quality each
questions.model: Teacher reads question 1 and models how to check the timeline before answering.

questions.q: which caliph would you most like to be like, and why? (two sentences)
questions.a: Pupils' own with a reason from his life

questions.q: what do all four caliphs have in common?
questions.a: Love for Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, justice and service of the ummah

questions.q: Back to our ponder: which caliph would you ask, and what?
